data.name: Sharuvik
data.gender_notes: Sharuvik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharuvik is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shara' meaning 'king' and 'Vik' meaning 'sun'. This name is believed to represent the one who rules over the sun and symbolizes strength and power. It is a perfect name for a baby boy born under the sun sign. The name Sharuvik carries the meaning “Ruler of the Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharuvik usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharuvik is a name of divine origin, representing the power and might of the Sun God. It is believed to bring blessings of strength, power, and success in all endeavors. This name is often used in Hindu religious and spiritual practices to invoke the blessings of the Sun God.
data.etymology: Sharuvik belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharuvik total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sharuvik carries a rich cultural impact in Hindu mythology and society. In Hinduism, the sun represents the divine and supreme power of the universe and is considered the king among celestial bodies. The name Sharuvik acknowledges and honors the sun's magnificent position in the cosmos and captures the essence of masculinity and authority.

Therefore, the name Sharuvik symbolizes the inner light and radiance that dwells within each individual and encourages personal growth and development towards enlightenment. This name serves as a constant reminder of the connection between the individual and the divine.
